_comment: Maintained by hand. 'sheets' maps reference images in Design/Object Designs/ (matched by filename substring) to gallery categories; images with no match still appear as unmapped references. 'planned' lists components seen on the reference sheets that do not exist as models yet (shown as MISSING), or phenomena rendered by shaders rather than meshes.
